minecraft:written_book_content.title: Swamp Camp Foreman's Log
minecraft:written_book_content.author: D. Mallory
pages: {"text": "Day 14. Still no monazite. Radio says the jungle camp found theirs on DAY TWO. Their foreman has magnets on his fridge. He has a FRIDGE."}
{"text": "Day 15. Fine. Lead, copper and zinc make bullets. This world needs a lot more bullets than it needs fridge magnets.\nI am not jealous."}

{"text": "Day 16. Bunk inspection. Found: one boot, a frog (alive), and Kozlowski's \"lucky rock.\"\nThe rock is monazite. He says it's from home. He is from a space station.\nRock confiscated. Frog stays."}

{"text": "Day 20. Pay docked.
Monazite found by the crew: 0.
Monazite found in Kozlowski's bunk: 1.
I keep it in my lockbox now. It's a nice rock."}
{"text": "Day 22. Someone reported a large creature in the swamp tonight. Long. Dark. Not a gator.\nThat's when we all heard Kozlowski scream."}
{"text": "Maybe that rock was lucky after all.\nGood thing we have lots of ammo."}
